texts.title: The Wound
texts.body: It will heal, the physicians say, and it will always show. {self.name} has looked at it in the glass. A person is not quite the same afterwards: slower on one side, and aware for the first time of having a body that can be broken.

choices.carry_on_as_before: Carry on as before, and be seen to.

texts.title: The Physicians' Verdict
texts.body: They are careful how they put it. {self.name} is not dying, they say; {self.name} is simply not going to get better. The strength that was there last year is not coming back. There is time. It would be wise to use it.

choices.spend_the_time_with_the_family: Spend the time with the family.

texts.title: An Old Friend
texts.body: {friend.name} of {friend.house} is in the city and has sent word, the way {friend.name} always does: no title, no business, a time and a place. They have known each other longer than either has held any office. There are not many people {self.name} can say that of.

texts.title: A Friend Is Buried
texts.body: The news came by an ordinary messenger on an ordinary day. They had been friends for longer than {self.name} has been most of the things {self.name} is. The house goes on around {self.name} as if nothing had happened.

texts.title: The Enemy Is Dead
texts.body: For years there was someone whose first thought on hearing {self.name}'s name was how to do {self.name} harm. That person is dead, of nothing {self.name} did. A part of how {self.name} has arranged a life was arranged against them.

texts.title: A Death In The House
texts.body: One of the house is dead, and the house must bury them. What was said over them is written in the book. How it is done is for {self.name} to decide, and will be remembered by everyone who was there.

choices.a_funeral_the_city_sees: A funeral the city will see.
choices.as_the_dead_would_have_wanted: As the dead would have wanted.

texts.title: The Elder At The Table
texts.body: {elder.name} laid the house down and has not quite laid it down. At dinner {elder.name} has an opinion on the matter before {self.name}, and the household has turned to hear it before {self.name} has spoken. {elder.name} ran this house for a long time.

choices.let_them_tell_it_their_way: Let them tell it their way.
